# gamepad

`controller_input.cpp`, `gamepad.hpp`, and `sdl_input.cpp` define the gamepad component boundary, controller runtime lifecycle, cursor behavior, mouse-activity tracking, and inert SDL integration.

## Contents

- [controller_input.cpp](./controller_input.cpp) defines `is_controller_active()`, `should_hide_cursor()`, `note_mouse_activity()`, and `component::post_load()`, which initializes and schedules the global `controller::runtime`.
- [gamepad.hpp](./gamepad.hpp) declares `is_controller_active()`, `should_hide_cursor()`, and `note_mouse_activity()`.
- [sdl_input.cpp](./sdl_input.cpp) defines the inert `sdl_input::component` with an empty `post_load()` override and disabled `REGISTER_COMPONENT(sdl_input::component)` registration.

## Subdirectories

- [controller/](./controller/) contains `controller::runtime`, timing, diagnostics, device discovery, drivers, calibration, mapping, sampling, transport, aim processing, and engine integration.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`component::post_load()` skips controller initialization when `no_controller` is active, constructs the global `controller::runtime`, installs `controller::engine`, schedules `engine_ready`, schedules recurring `frame`, and registers shutdown cleanup through `keys().release_all()`.

`controller::runtime::engine_ready()` runs after `100ms`, while `controller::runtime::frame()` runs every `16ms`; `is_controller_active()`, `should_hide_cursor()`, and `note_mouse_activity()` bridge runtime state to the gamepad component boundary.

## API Surface

`is_controller_active() -> bool`, `should_hide_cursor() -> bool`, and `note_mouse_activity() -> void` define the public gamepad input-state interface.

`component::post_load() override` defines component startup behavior, and `sdl_input::component::post_load() override` preserves an inert SDL component path.

## Behavioral Contracts

`component::post_load()` constructs `controller::runtime` with `DEBUG == true` in debug builds and `DEBUG == false` otherwise.

`component::post_load()` schedules `engine_ready` after `100ms`, schedules `frame` every `16ms`, and invokes `keys().release_all()` during shutdown.

`runtime` remains a global `unique_ptr`, and `REGISTER_COMPONENT(component)` registers the active gamepad component.

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(sdl_input::component)` remains disabled.
